evidence_scope: Public papers and author implementations; no assertion of institutional live adoption or profitable deployment. Research mechanisms are not independent market evidence.
selection_reason: Self-supervised objectives change representation learning before sparse noisy return supervision; reuse verified inputs while keeping prior Value-Weight fixed version closed.

methods.mechanism_zh: 通过数据适配与模型适配应对分布变化，逐步更新预测模型。
